sentences.text:
Advocate for the Petitioner : Ms G Deka
Advocate for the Respondent : Pp, Assam
Before Hon'Ble Mrs. Justice Susmita Phukan Khaund 23.03.2023
1.

Heard Ms. G. Deka, learned counsel appearing for the petitioner as well as Ms. S.H. Borah,
learned Addl. P.P. appearing for the State respondent.

2.  The petitioner, namely, Jitu Mahanta has filed this application under Section 438 Cr.P.C Page No.# 2/2 with prayer for pre-arrest bail as he is apprehending arrest in connection with PRC Case No. 413/2022, under Sections 376 IPC, arising out of Goreswar P.S. Case No. 57/2020.
3.
The allegation against the petitioner is that the petitioner induced the victim into having a physical relationship with him with false promises of marriage.
The petitioner impregnated the victim and when the victim has informed him about her pregnancy, the petitioner fraudulently got medicine administered to the victim, which resulted in her abortion.
Charge-sheet has been laid against the petitioner under Section 376 IPC.
A co- ordinate Bench of this Court had earlier rejected the pre-arrest bail under section 438 Cr.P.C filed by the petitioner in A.B. No. 1309/2020 vide order dated 16.10.2020.

5.
I have considered the submissions at the Bar and I have also perused the LCR.
The case is pending in the Court of Judicial Magistrate First Class at Baksa, Mushalpur.

sentences.text: The petitioner is not shown as an absconder in the charge-sheet.
6. After considering the submissions at the Bar, the petitioner is granted interim bail up to 10.04.2023.

The petitioner is directed to appear before the Court below and apply for regular bail,
which will be considered by the learned Court below as per merits of this case.
7.
Meanwhile, In the event of his arrest, the petitioner shall be enlarged on bail of Rs. 50,000/- with a suitable surety of like amount to the satisfaction of the arresting authority till 10.04.2023.
